Q6097.reason: Most states abolish or convert the fee tail into a fee simple, so the cousin took the whole fee and the man had nothing left to convey to the niece.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on x-rays he reviewed using accepted medical practice, so the testimony is admissible.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into a hotel room (a dwelling) at night with intent to threaten satisfies burglary, while A lacks intent at entry, B lacks an entry, and C involves an open window in the afternoon.
